relationships.rationale: Chips cannot enter service without a hall to land in.
A shell is not an operating AI factory until it can take grid or onsite power.
High-density AI halls require heat removal matched to rack power.
Study results typically require physical upgrades before energization.
Load and generation interconnects need LPT/GSU hardware.
Interconnection is worthless if the region has no energy/capacity to serve the load.
Substation cutovers wait on transformer delivery.
Breakers and GIS/AIS are required to operate a substation.
Campus MV/HV distribution is required to move power from the fence to IT halls.
Behind-the-meter or dedicated generation is the main substitute when grid connection is slow.
New thermal generation adds the energy/capacity new load needs.
Turbines still need GSU transformers to reach usable voltage.
New generation requires its own siting and air/water permits.
Accelerator deployment is the load that consumes regional power.
Cooling plants are large electrical loads inside the same campus electrical architecture.
